title: QdrantServerless Rust Client
mini_srs: This milestone delivers the QdrantServerless client for the Rust SDK, a parallel client targeting the managed serverless offering with tenant-facing collection management and point operations. The prototype (d5a4f44, PR #295) introduces the serverless module at src/serverless/ with client, conversions, gRPC bindings, and models (+1871 LoC). Subsequent commits add paginated ListCollections with offset tokens and text index options including keyword prefix and stemmer support (8c14f9f, PR #296, +399 LoC), expose response time on all CollectionsService RPCs (bfd6205, PR #297), and add the FULL precision tier for exact f32 vectors (40a7286, PR #298). The feature is verified through explicit field deconstruction in conversions that turns new proto fields into compile errors.
expansion_rationale: DAG chain d5a4f44->8c14f9f->bfd6205 plus d5a4f44->40a7286 confirmed via edges_dag with extend/modify_overlap on src/serverless/{client.rs,conversions.rs,grpc.rs,models.rs,mod.rs}. Patches verified: bfd6205 adds time:f64 to all gRPC response structs and CreateCollectionResult/DeleteCollectionResult models; 40a7286 adds Full variant to PrecisionTier enum in grpc.rs, conversions.rs, and models.rs. All four commits share the same author (qdrant-cloud-bot) and sequential PR numbers #295-#298, confirming a single feature stream.

title: QdrantServerless Python Client
mini_srs: This milestone delivers the QdrantServerless client for the Python SDK, providing both sync and async clients for the managed serverless offering with tenant-facing collection management. The prototype (7e917d1, PR #1393) creates the entire qdrant_client/serverless/ package with async_client.py, client.py, conversions.py, models.py, gRPC bindings, and a standalone serverless_collections.proto (+3660 LoC). Follow-up commits expose response time on all CollectionsService RPCs including create, delete, get, and list in both sync and async clients (1a8140b, PR #1452, +108-54 LoC), and add the FULL precision tier for exact f32 vectors in the PrecisionTier enum and proto (9f47286, PR #1507). The feature uses pydantic BaseModel for models and supports gRPC channel pooling via the parent Qdrant client.
expansion_rationale: DAG chain 7e917d1->1a8140b->9f47286 confirmed via edges_dag with modify_overlap/extend on serverless/{async_client.py,client.py,grpc/serverless_collections_pb2.py,models.py,proto/serverless_collections.proto}. Patches verified: 1a8140b adds time:float fields to all response models (CreateCollectionResult, DeleteCollectionResult, CollectionInfo, CollectionsList) and updates both sync and async client methods; 9f47286 adds FULL=4 to PrecisionTier proto enum and the conversion map. Mirror of the Rust client feature stream with same sub-features (response time then precision tier).
